description: This file defines the Error package, including classes Error and Error::Simple, for OO-style error and exception handling in Perl. It includes methods for creating, throwing, catching, and managing errors, as well as handling stack traces and error propagation.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error objects, providing methods for error creation, propagation, and introspection.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: Subclass of Error for simple string-based errors with optional file, line, and value information.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides exception handling syntax such as try, catch, finally, except, and otherwise.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: Handles warning and die signal processing, including stack trace generation and error reporting.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new error object, capturing package, file, line, and other info.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws the error object, causing it to be caught or terminate the program.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a new error object for syntactic sugar, e.g., die with Error.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Creates and returns an error object for recording without throwing.

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the stack trace if debugging is enabled, or a brief message otherwise.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error with an object for error propagation.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Returns the filename where the error was created.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error was created.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Overloaded method to convert error object to string, typically the error message.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns an associated value, e.g., error code.
